primitives.name: Contradictive Compound Sentiment
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model Per-channel sentiment scoring with multiple base models; aggregate temporal metrics including a "contradictive" compound: contradictive = SQRT(positive × ABS(negative)).
primitives.assumptions: Sentiment scores are normalized; positive and negative components are independent; contradictive captures tension between opposing sentiments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When either positive or negative approaches zero, contradictive becomes undefined or negligible.

layer2.mapping: Used as core feature in GSE's compound sentiment indicator to detect conflicting sentiment trends across news channels.
layer2.telemetry: Daily contradictive score per entity, aggregated over 2024 NFL season for lagged correlation analysis.

primitives.name: Selectively Weighted Sentiment Indicator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Correlations of sentiment metrics with market moves at lags 0/1/2 days; a selectively weighted compound indicator combining channels and metrics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'w_i': 'dimensionless weight for channel i', 's_i': 'sentiment metric (e.g., contradictive, positive, negative) for channel i'}
primitives.assumptions: Weights are fixed post-hoc based on training data; sentiment metrics are temporally aligned with market data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When weights become unstable or data drifts beyond training period.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE’s compound sentiment indicator for forecasting fantasy performance errors using lagged sentiment features.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation of compound indicator with GSE projection error at 1–7 day lags.

primitives.name: Lagged Correlation Between Sentiment and Market Movement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Correlations of sentiment metrics with market moves at lags 0/1/2 days; a selectively weighted compound indicator combining channels and metrics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_t': 'sentiment metric at time t', 'M_{t+k}': 'market movement at time t+k', 'k': 'time lag in days', 'rho': 'dimensionless correlation coefficient'}

The core insight is that sentiment can be decomposed into directional components—positive and negative—and their interaction captured via a 'contradictive' measure. This is mathematically expressed as a geometric mean of absolute values, emphasizing tension rather than simple aggregation. The selectively weighted indicator extends this by assigning variable importance to different channels or metrics, forming a linear combination. Lagged correlation then tests predictive power by aligning sentiment signals with future market outcomes. These primitives form a dual framework: one for capturing sentiment structure (contradictive), another for combining it meaningfully (weighted indicator), and a third for validating its utility (lagged correlation). Failure modes include overfitting to specific lags or ignoring data drift. The method assumes stationarity and stability of sentiment-channel relationships, which may not hold under regime shifts.
